config.title: Client settings
config.description: Apply to every openDox client connected to this server. Clients pick up changes at startup and after at most 10 minutes.
config.liveView: Live view on by default (users can toggle it in the client)

micModes.toggle: Press to start, press again to stop

config.clipboardExclude: Keep inserted text out of clipboard history and cloud clipboard (Windows)
config.clipboardClearHint: Only if it hasn't changed since. 0 = never clear.
config.allowlistHint: Empty = insert into any program. Otherwise the client asks before inserting into an unlisted program. Example: medistar.exe
config.note: These values take precedence over a local settings.json on the machines.

distribution.title: Distribute the client
distribution.description: One installer for all machines. The connection to this server lives in a small settings.json copied next to the program.
distribution.serverUrlHint: If the address is wrong (e.g. clients reach the server under a different name), set CLIENT_SERVER_URL in the server configuration.
distribution.singleHint: Single machine: run the installer and copy settings.json to {{dir}}.
